name: Iron ore haul
description: Example job. Mine raw iron ore and deliver it to the Stetheros depot.
details:
What is needed:
- At least 10 stacks of raw iron ore
- Delivered to the depot chest in Stetheros

Pay is per 10 stacks; partial loads are paid pro rata.
